What we deliver

Sub-services tailored to your stage

Each ui/ux design engagement is shaped by the problem in front of us — these are the lanes we typically work in.

User Research

Understand your users' needs and behaviors

We start every project by talking to real users — moderated interviews, unmoderated tests, and analytics deep-dives. The output is not a persona poster; it is a clear, prioritized list of jobs-to-be-done your design has to do well.

  • User interviews and contextual inquiry
  • Jobs-to-be-done and opportunity mapping
  • Usability testing on Figma or live prototypes
  • Insight-to-design handoff briefs

Wireframing

Blueprint your app's structure and flow

Before pixels, we draw the skeleton. Low-fidelity wireframes for every key flow, validated against your IA, and iterated fast. Wireframes are the cheapest place to make the most expensive mistakes — so we do not skip them.

  • Low-fidelity wireframes for every flow
  • Information architecture and navigation
  • User flow diagrams and edge cases
  • Engineering review before visual design

Visual Design

Stunning interfaces that reflect your brand

High-fidelity Figma files, a real type and color system, and motion principles that match your brand personality. The output is a Figma library your team can keep using long after we are done — not a static deliverable.

  • High-fidelity Figma screens and components
  • Type, color, and motion systems
  • Brand-aligned iconography and illustration
  • Light, dark, and brand variants

Prototyping

Interactive prototypes for testing ideas

Clickable prototypes for stakeholder review, user testing, and crowdfunding. We build them in Figma or with code, depending on fidelity needs — and we use them to test the riskiest assumptions before you spend a dirham on engineering.

  • Figma and code-based prototypes
  • Micro-interactions and motion specs
  • Testable flows for user research
  • Stakeholder demo builds

FAQ

Questions we hear most often

  • Do you also build the design in code?
    Yes. Most of our engagements end with a working front end. We can ship Astro, Next.js, SvelteKit, or React Native — whatever your stack prefers. The handoff is smooth because we are the same team doing both.
  • Can you take over an existing design system?
    Frequently. We start with a design system audit, propose a path to clean it up, and ship it in a Storybook that your engineers actually use. We have rescued Figma files with 2,000+ components and turned them into something maintainable.
  • How do you handle accessibility?
    Accessibility is not a checklist we run at the end. We design for keyboard, screen readers, and color contrast from the first wireframe, and we test with real assistive tech before handoff. WCAG AA is our default; AAA where it matters.
  • What if I only have a brand, not a product idea?
    That is a great place to start. We run a 2-week discovery sprint that ends in a product brief, a feature list, and a prototype you can use to raise, recruit, or sell. From there, we can design and build the first version.
